source: Read-only effective email form values; both events independently inspected; all 40 text fields identical. Relevant draft templates below.

street-dance-workshop-dd-dev.name: mail_text_download_reminder_0
street-dance-workshop-dd-dev.value:
Hello,

you bought a ticket for {event}.

If you did not do so already, you can download your ticket here:
{url}

Best regards,  
Your {event} team

street-dance-workshop-dd-dev.name: mail_text_download_reminder_1
mail_text_order_approved_free_0
street-dance-workshop-dd-dev.value:
Hello,

we approved your order for {event} and will be happy to welcome you
at our event. As you only ordered free products, no payment is required.

You can change your order details and view the status of your order at
{url}

Best regards,  
Your {event} team

street-dance-workshop-dd-dev.name: mail_text_order_approved_free_1
street-dance-workshop-dd-dev.value:
Hej,

vi har godkendt din bestilling til arrangementet {event} og glæder os til at byde dig velkommen
til vores arrangement. Da du udelukkende har bestilt gratis produkter, skal du ikke betale noget.

Du kan ændre dine bestillingsoplysninger og se status på din bestilling her:

{url}

Med venlig hilsen,  

Dit {event}-team

street-dance-workshop-dd-dev.name: mail_text_order_canceled_0
street-dance-workshop-dd-dev.value:

your order {code} for {event} has been canceled.

{comment}

You can view the details of your order at
{url}

Best regards,  
Your {event} team

mail_text_order_paid_0
street-dance-workshop-dd-dev.value:

we successfully received your payment for {event}. Thank you!

{payment_info}

You can change your order details and view the status of your order at
{url}

Best regards,  
Your {event} team

street-dance-workshop-dd-dev.name: mail_text_order_paid_1
mail_text_order_payment_failed_0
street-dance-workshop-dd-dev.value:
Hello,

your payment attempt for your order for {event} has failed.

Your order is still valid and you can try to pay again using the same or a different payment method. Please complete your payment before {expire_date}.

You can retry the payment and view the status of your order at
{url}

Best regards,  
Your {event} team

street-dance-workshop-dd-dev.name: mail_text_order_payment_failed_1
street-dance-workshop-dd-dev.value:
Hej,

dit betalingsforsøg for din bestilling til arrangementet {event} mislykkedes.

Din bestilling er stadig gyldig, og du kan prøve at betale igen med samme eller en anden betalingsmetode. Du bedes gennemføre betalingen inden {expire_date}.

Du kan prøve at betale igen og se status på din bestilling her:

{url}

Med venlig hilsen,  

Dit {event}-team

street-dance-workshop-dd-dev.name: mail_text_order_placed_0
street-dance-workshop-dd-dev.value:
Hello,

we successfully received your order for {event} with a total value
of {total_with_currency}. Please complete your payment before {expire_date}.

{payment_info}

You can change your order details and view the status of your order at
{url}

Best regards,  
Your {event} team

street-dance-workshop-dd-dev.name: mail_text_order_placed_1
mail_text_order_placed_require_approval_0
street-dance-workshop-dd-dev.value:
Hello,

we successfully received your order for {event}. Since you ordered
a product that requires approval by the event organizer, we ask you to
be patient and wait for our next email.

You can change your order details and view the status of your order at
{url}

Best regards,  
Your {event} team

street-dance-workshop-dd-dev.name: mail_text_order_placed_require_approval_1
street-dance-workshop-dd-dev.value:
Hej,

vi har modtaget din bestilling til arrangementet {event}. Da du har bestilt
et produkt, der kræver godkendelse fra arrangøren, beder vi dig om
at være tålmodig og afvente vores næste e-mail.

Du kan ændre dine bestillingsoplysninger og se status på din bestilling her:

{url}

Med venlig hilsen,  

Dit {event}-team

street-dance-workshop-dd-dev.name: mail_text_resend_link_0
street-dance-workshop-dd-dev.value:
Hello,

you receive this message because you asked us to send you the link
to your order for {event}.

You can change your order details and view the status of your order at
{url}

Best regards,  
Your {event} team
